lines.text: Go shopping, not go to shopping!
Many learners say: I went to shopping.

native.tip: Türkçede “alışverişe gitmek” deriz ama İngilizcede “go shopping” denir.
native.caption: “I went to shopping” mi diyorsun? 😅 Doğrusu “I went shopping.” Carlos’u dinle ve tekrar et! Lexkite uygulamasını aç, daha çok pratik yap.
native.comment: Cevap: “shopping”. Go ile shopping arasına to girmez. Ücretsiz testle pratik yap: {link}

en.caption: Do you say “I went to shopping”? 😅 English says go shopping, without “to”. The right sentence is “I went shopping.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Open the Lexkite app and practice more.
